Download **Videos-Downloader-Setup-x.x.x.exe** from the Assets below and run it.

- Paste a YouTube playlist (or video) link, pick what you want, and download it as **MP4** video or **MP3** audio
- Each playlist gets its own folder, with files numbered in playlist order
- Everything it needs (yt-dlp and ffmpeg) is included, so no Python is required
- The app updates itself when a new version is released

> Windows may show "Windows protected your PC" because the installer isn't code-signed. Click **More info → Run anyway**.

Only download content you have the right to download.
